name: Marion County, SC
findings: Marion County has 73 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marion County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Marion County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
